title: poa annua subsp. supina
intro: Poa annua subsp. supina, commonly known as False Brome or Poverty Grass, is a perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities that contribute to its health benefits, such as treating fever, sore throat, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Poa annua subsp. supina include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential and bioactive constituents.
